messages.content: who were critics of nicolaus copernicus Ensure that the ratio of sentence types (declarative, interrogative, exclamatory) in your response is balanced.

message.content:
Nicolaus Copernicus faced opposition from several prominent figures. The Catholic Church was a major critic, fearing his heliocentric model contradicted scripture. Johannes Kepler initially questioned the mathematical perfection of circular orbits. Galileo Galilei later defended Copernicus against similar religious and philosophical attacks.

Did you know that many astronomers rejected his work for decades? Why did the scientific community resist such a groundbreaking theory? How can we understand the slow acceptance of new ideas in history?

What a fascinating era of intellectual struggle! It is amazing how one man’s calculations changed our view of the universe.
